settings.prior: model.from_unit (inverse normal CDF times prior sd; u clipped to [1e-300, 1 - 2**-53])

snapshot.rule: Among bounds with a single neural bound (one local coordinate frame for N3), the one whose learned region is the smallest fraction of its sampling union at creation (lowest neural acceptance); without such bounds, the lowest acceptance overall.

cdf_a_sup.note: sup |weighted CDF - reference CDF| of a over 801 points on [-4, 4]. Over 20 seeds at this n_live the value is +0.0085 +- 0.0006 (mean +- SE; sd 0.0027); this run ranks 12 of 20 by |value| (1 = largest). See seed_ensemble.

cdf_b_sup.note: sup |weighted CDF - reference CDF| of b over 801 points on [-4, 4]. Over 20 seeds at this n_live the value is +0.0084 +- 0.0005 (mean +- SE; sd 0.0023); this run ranks 15 of 20 by |value| (1 = largest). See seed_ensemble.

e_a2.note: E[a^2] from the weighted posterior versus quadrature. Over 20 seeds at this n_live the error is +0.0001 +- 0.0012 (mean +- SE; sd 0.0055); this run ranks 15 of 20 by |error| (1 = largest). See seed_ensemble.

exploration_kept.note: Same run with discard_exploration=False (the setter recomputes the shell information). Exploration points can carry pseudo-importance bias; the trace's estimates use discard_exploration=True.

kish_ess.note: Kish 1/sum(wbar^2) of the exported posterior weights (samplingdemo.diagnostics.weight_ess). For Nautilus's estimator it equals sampler.n_eff algebraically, so agreement checks the exported weights; it measures weight concentration, not mode coverage.

likelihood_accounting.note: Every likelihood call is either stored by Nautilus or a dropped transfer candidate (n_like = stored + dropped).

log_z.note: sampler.log_z (discard_exploration=True) versus the quadrature reference. Nautilus 1.0.6 reports no evidence uncertainty. Over 20 seeds at this n_live the error is +0.0003 +- 0.0017 (mean +- SE; sd 0.0078); this run ranks 13 of 20 by |error| (1 = largest). See seed_ensemble.

n_eff_nautilus.note: Nautilus's own shell-based effective sample size (sampler.n_eff); the run stops once it reaches the n_eff setting.

p_positive.note: P(a>0) from the weighted posterior; 0.5 by the sign symmetry of B. Over 20 seeds at this n_live the error is +0.0025 +- 0.0009 (mean +- SE; sd 0.0041); this run ranks 5 of 20 by |error| (1 = largest). See seed_ensemble.

seed_ensemble.note: Reference recovery over 20 independent seeds with this trace's settings and n_live (spec §14.3): per-seed errors against the quadrature reference (cdf_*_sup: sup CDF discrepancy), mean, sample sd, standard error and n. The displayed run is seed 1, fixed before any run (not selected for appearance) and the first ensemble member; displayed_rank counts the seeds whose |value| is at least the displayed run's (1 = most extreme).

snapshot_coverage.note: REFERENCE ONLY (log L computed offline, never available to the sampler). calibrated: fraction of the prior mass of {log L >= log_l_min} (unit-square grid cells) inside the accepted region; target mass outside the sampling union counts as lost, so a mode no live point reached raises the warning. filter_only: fraction of in-union candidates with log L >= log_l_min that the neural filter keeps; blind to target mass outside the union.

calibrated.message: proposal keeps 98.0% of the unit-square grid cells (whole prior) with log L >= log_l_min

filter_only.message: proposal keeps 97.0% of the in-union candidates (filter only) with log L >= log_l_min

snapshot_cut_check.note: polyval(polyfit(score, emulator.predict(local), 3), min live score) reproduces NeuralBound.score_predict_min bitwise for every neural bound.

snapshot_volume.note: Accepted-region area: midpoint rule on the N5 grid versus the library's Monte Carlo estimate exp(log_v) (outer-union volume times neural acceptance).

uninstrumented_equivalence.note: A plain nautilus.Sampler run with the same settings and seed gave bitwise identical outputs.

reference_only.note: REFERENCE ONLY: true log L of candidates the neural filter rejected, computed offline for the sensitivity view. Never a sampler call, never a training point.

sensitivity.note: Proposal-only sensitivity view: every neural cut is shifted by the same amount on the frozen candidate bank and the N5 grid. Captured fractions use reference-only log L: fraction_captured (and the warning) over the whole prior grid, filter_fraction_captured over in-union candidates only. Posterior and evidence diagnostics do not apply to a shifted cut.

streams.candidate_bank: numpy.random.default_rng(SeedSequence(seed).spawn(1)[0]) (PCG64), used only on a deep copy of the snapshot bound
streams.networks: sklearn MLPRegressor random_state = network index 0..n_networks-1 (MT19937), fixed by nautilus 1.0.6
streams.sampler: numpy.random.default_rng(seed) inside nautilus.Sampler (PCG64): unit-cube and bound sampling, GaussianMixture splits
streams.seed_ensemble: numpy.random.default_rng(seed) inside nautilus.Sampler for each seed in ensemble_seeds
